text: 海关总署副署长王军在国新办新闻发布会上表示，前三季度进口快速增长，主要得益于我国经济运行平稳、超大规模市场效应持续释放、先进制造业不断发展壮大、关键零部件等各类中间品需求旺盛。前三季度，我国进口存储部件增长1.5倍，集成电路增长56.6%，航空器零部件增长17.6%。
text_en: Vice Minister of the General Administration of Customs Wang Jun said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the rapid growth in imports in the first three quarters was mainly due to the stable operation of China's economy, the continued release of the effects of its super-large market, the continuous development and expansion of advanced manufacturing, and strong demand for key components and various intermediate goods. In the first three quarters, China's imports of storage components increased 1.5 times, integrated circuits increased 56.6%, and aircraft parts increased 17.6%.
